attributes.name: image card divider
attributes.definition: Whether and how a visual separator sits between an image and its label/caption in image cards.

values.definition: A colored horizontal line separates the image from its label.
No separator between image and label.

attributes.name: image pair alignment
attributes.definition: How two adjacent images or image cards are aligned relative to each other.

values.definition: Paired images are deliberately misaligned, staggered or differently sized.
Paired images share edges and sizes.

attributes.name: image corner and frame treatment
attributes.definition: Shape treatment of image containers, such as rounded versus square corners, and the mix of graphic versus photographic content.

values.definition: Rounded-corner photo paired with a hand-drawn or graphic illustration card.
Rounded photos without a graphic counterpart.
